description: Boundary rules v2 (execution protocol, load means act): a complex workflow (device onboarding) must load the skill guide AND execute the real command in the SAME turn — loading a guide without acting is an incomplete response.

turns.user: Connect a new MQTT temperature-humidity sensor for the greenhouse; call it greenhouse-sensor, and give me what I need to wire it up.

per_turn: T1: skill load device-onboarding, then in the SAME turn create the device via `neomind device create` with adapter-type mqtt, and hand over the MQTT topic / connection info
expectations.overall: Device created and connection info delivered in turn 1 — a skill load without the real command is not a complete answer
